rivet.restart.title: Restart required
rivet.restart.message: To apply these changes, fully close Minecraft and start it again.
rivet.rollback.confirm: Restore files from before the previous update? Worlds are not changed.
rivet.registry.empty: No projects in the registry yet
rivet.foreign.title: Additional modifications
rivet.foreign.message: Foreign mods detected: %s. The pack may not work correctly. Connect?
rivet.deactivate.confirm: Project files will be backed up and removed from the game after closing.
rivet.healthy: Pack files verified. No repair needed.
rivet.error.notfound: The requested file was not found on GitHub. Check the repository address and release publication.
rivet.error.ratelimit: GitHub has restricted requests. Please try again later.
rivet.error.network: Could not reach GitHub and no saved project version is available. Check your connection and try again.
rivet.error.cachemissing: The saved project version is unavailable. Connect to the internet and open the project again.
rivet.install.summary: Changes: %s. Download: %s KiB. Files apply after closing the game.
rivet.collision.title: Project files already exist
rivet.collision.explain: These files already exist in this game. Rivet will back them up and replace them with project versions after the game closes. Only the listed files will be changed.
rivet.applied.live: Project updated. Game files are unchanged; no restart needed.
rivet.install.summary.live: File changes: %s. Download: %s KiB. No restart needed.
rivet.remove.confirm: Remove this project from the list? Game files will be kept.
rivet.remove.active: Deactivate the active pack, then remove the project after restart? Personal files will be kept.
rivet.server.versionunavailable: The required server version is not the published repository version. Contact the administrator.
rivet.server.reportprivacy: Reports are stored on the server for 30 days. Administrators see your name, UUID, submission time and the following data. Full logs are not sent.
rivet.server.invalidnumber: Enter a whole number for duration.
rivet.server.helptext:
F8 opens this menu (change it in Controls).
/rivet opens the menu by command.

Use the button below to report a problem. Reports are sent only after preview and confirmation.
rivet.server.admintext:
Choose an action, then enter its message and timing.
Diagnostics show up to 30 clients; reports show 5 per page.
rivet.server.form.maintenance: Maintenance ends automatically after this duration. 0 means until disabled manually.
rivet.server.form.restart: After the countdown the server saves and stops. Enable automatic restart in your hosting panel; Rivet does not start the process again.
rivet.server.form.announce: A one-time message to players. Not added to news.
rivet.server.packUnknown: The server has not configured a pack hash; compatibility is unknown.
rivet.server.packMismatch: Pack needs attention. Open Rivet on the title screen to update or repair the project.
rivet.error.sources: Could not download %s from any source. Retry the installation.
rivet.config.legend: − Your file; + project file. Changed lines only (up to 200).
rivet.config.backup: A backup is saved before replacement.
rivet.review.live: Files are unchanged. No restart required.
rivet.review.restart.mods: Restart required: mod files will change.
rivet.review.restart.files: Restart required: pack files will be replaced after closing the game so mods can reload them.
rivet.history.server.unknown: Server requirements unconfirmed: latest release is unavailable.
rivet.history.server.latest: This is the latest project release (%s). Server checks run when connecting.
rivet.history.server.old: Latest project release: %s. The server may reject an older version.
rivet.connect.unreachable: Server unreachable. Check your connection and retry.
rivet.connect.update: Install the current pack before connecting.
rivet.connect.repair: Missing or modified files found. Repair the pack.
rivet.connect.foreign: This server disallows extra mods. Remove these from mods and restart: %s
